provenance.description: Deterministic evaluation of the original university-project saved DDPG and TD3 actor checkpoints.
provenance.training_status: Historical checkpoint results; the standalone public project did not freshly train these models.
provenance.checkpoint_policy: The private reference checkpoints are not included in, copied to, or required by the standalone public project.

metric_definitions.total_reward: Sum of per-step rewards over the rollout.
metric_definitions.final_depth_error: Absolute target-depth error at the final recorded state.
metric_definitions.maximum_depth_overshoot: Maximum recorded depth above the target, lower-bounded at zero.
metric_definitions.squared_action_effort: Time integral approximation of the sum of squared control actions.
metric_definitions.total_action_variation: Sum of absolute successive changes across both control actions.
